questions.question: The Sun rises in the:
questions.explanation: Due to Earth’s west-to-east rotation, the Sun appears to rise in the east.

questions.question: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.explanation: It was launched on 8 August 1942.

questions.question: How many bones are there in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.

questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar"?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to flooding.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: "Vidhan Sabha" refers to the:
questions.explanation: Vidhan Sabha is the State Legislative Assembly.

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: Who is known as the "Father of the Indian Constitution"?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the drafting committee.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.C: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
questions.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Who was the last Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the last and only Indian Governor-General.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is appointed by the:
questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: The currency of the United States is the:
questions.explanation: The US currency is the Dollar.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: The Davis Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Davis Cup is a men’s team tennis event.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The Western Ghats run parallel to which coast of India?
questions.explanation: The Western Ghats run along the western coast.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: The currency of Japan is the:
questions.explanation: Japan’s currency is the Yen.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: The term of a member of the Lok Sabha is normally:
questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 49. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 49/7 = 7. Larger = 4 × 7 = 28.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 10 days and B in 40 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/10 + 1/40 = 50/400. Time = 400/50 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 14 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √1024.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹630. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 10% of 300.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their difference is 16. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 16, so each part = 8. Smaller = 3 × 8 = 24.

questions.question: A boat travels 45 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 45/3 = 15 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 15 − 2 = 13 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of ∛4913.
A train 180 m long crosses a platform 120 m long in 15 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 + 120 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

An article costing ₹1000 is sold for ₹1250. Find the profit percentage.

Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 63. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 63/7 = 9. Larger = 5 × 9 = 45.

questions.question: A train 100 m long crosses a pole in 5 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 19 days?
questions.explanation: 19 mod 7 = 5; Tuesday + 5 = Sunday.

questions.question: Which letter is 7th to the right of the 8th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 8th letter = H; 8 + 7 = 15th letter = O.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (7, 343), (6, 216), (5, 125), (4, 67)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 4³ = 64, not 67.

questions.question: In a row of 27 students, Ravi is 23rd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 27 − 23 + 1 = 5.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 2²…6². Next is 7² = 49.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 4, 8, 13, 19, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 7, so 19 + 7 = 26.

questions.question: If DOG is coded as FQI, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to SUN gives UWP.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 1:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 1:00 the angle is 1 × 30° = 30°.
The relation is squaring: 4² = 16, so 11² = 121.

questions.question: A person walks 9 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 5 + 6 × 5.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 5 × 6 − 5 = 30 − 5 = 25.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 54 × 3 = 162.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 23, 29, 2, 16
questions.explanation: 23, 29, 2 are prime numbers; 16 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 5th letter from the right is the 22nd from the left = V.
The relation is cubing: 3³ = 27, so 6³ = 216.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 29 days?
questions.explanation: 29 mod 7 = 1; Friday + 1 = Saturday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 14th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 14th letter = N; 14 + 4 = 18th letter = R.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (3, 27), (6, 216), (7, 343), (9, 732)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 732.

questions.question: In a row of 38 students, Ravi is 9th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 38 − 9 + 1 = 30.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 7, so 21 + 7 = 28.

questions.question: If BIRD is coded as ELUG, how is STAR coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to STAR gives VWDU.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 5² = 25, so 10² = 100.
